instruction: Facade WWR And Overhang Retrofit From Init Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 1 space and 1 thermal zone. Name the OS:Space V14-Base. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 total OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surface, 1 roof/ceiling surface and 4 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground and 5 Outdoors. Add 4 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 62.72 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Add 1 OS:ShadingSurface object with total shading surface area 24.14 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 1 ideal-loads air system, 1 zone HVAC equipment list and 1 dual-setpoint thermostat. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 22.00 m in X, 14.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 308.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 230.40 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
